audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0].text, content.early, and wants.foe[2] all attribute Renata's root to her W ('W's rooting daisy-chain', 'the slow W daisy root', 'Root your engage with W daisy'), but per enemyAbilities/enemyKit the root is Q (Handshake); W is Bailout, a death-delay/revive buff with no root.
audit.why: This is a real ability-function error, not a name typo — a reader following 'watch her W root' would be watching the wrong button. Q Handshake roots the first enemy hit; W Bailout has no CC at all.
audit.corrected: All three fields rewritten to credit the root to Q Handshake and describe W (Bailout) correctly.

audit.whatIsWrong: missingInteractions flags Renata's Bailout (W) sustain as needing Grievous Wounds timing, unstated; breakdown.cooldowns has no digit and packet.defects calls out missing cooldown-sequencing advice.
audit.why: Bailout delays a death and can revive on a takedown — a concrete anti-heal note and real cooldown numbers give the reader something to time against.
audit.corrected: Folded into dosFull[1].d and breakdown.cooldowns with real numbers.

audit.why: Even overall (5.5/10) with a late swing to Renata already stated in content.late and win[6].

edits.before: Get 2 first and Q Dredge Line the moment Renata steps up: she's a squishy enchanter with no hard CC of her own besides W's rooting daisy-chain, so your hook-plus-root all-in bursts her fast with Titan's Wrath covering the return poke.
edits.after: Get 2 first and Q Dredge Line the moment Renata steps up: she's a squishy enchanter whose only hard CC is her own Q Handshake root, so your hook-plus-root all-in bursts her fast with Titan's Wrath covering the return poke.

edits.before: You crush Renata in lane early: she's a fragile enchanter whose only self-peel is the slow W daisy root, so your level 1-2 Q hook and passive chain lock her for an easy burst under Titan's Wrath. Force short trades onto her the moment she steps up to poke or shield, and she has no way to punch back.
edits.after: You crush Renata in lane early: she's a fragile enchanter whose only self-peel is her own Q Handshake root, so your level 1-2 Q hook and passive chain lock her for an easy burst under Titan's Wrath. Force short trades onto her the moment she steps up to poke or shield, and she has no way to punch back.

edits.before: Root your engage with W daisy to kite you off
edits.after: Root your engage with Handshake (Q) to kite you off

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Bailout (W) delays a death and revives allies on a takedown — buy anti-heal early to blunt the sustain window it buys.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with intentions.
edits.after: Her Loyalty Program (E) missiles shield and slow on chip pokes — anchoring minions just eats free damage into it.

edits.before: World Atlas start. Locket or Zeke's line, Mercs-Steelcaps by lane, then Knight's Vow paths. Add anti-heal early into his duo’s sustain.
edits.after: World Atlas start. Locket or Zeke's line, Mercs-Steelcaps by lane, then Knight's Vow paths. Add anti-heal early into her duo’s sustain.

edits.before: - Renata Glasc Hostile Takeover: matchup-defining — The berserk wave turns your team on itself — never group in a line against it. It writes your spacing rules. - W Titan's Wrath is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Renata's Hostile Takeover (R) is 150/130/110s — never group in a line against it, it turns your team on itself. - Your Titan's Wrath (W) is a 12s shield, for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - Her Bailout (W), 28-24s, can revive a takedown — confirm the kill before it triggers.
